raw_reason: Date of Article and/or Notice Unknown
canonical_reason: Date of Article and/or Notice Unknown
definition_used: The article and/or notice do not have clear publication dates. RW may also use this reason when a publisher overwrites the original article’s HTML page with the notice, without changing the publication date to reflect the change.
caution: This reason is a metadata transparency signal about missing or overwritten dates, not a direct indicator of research content or authorship issues. It supports post-publication transparency only broadly.
semantic_rationale: The definition describes unclear or overwritten publication dates, which is a notice opacity issue under post-publication transparency, with the journal/publisher as the relevant actor context.
